| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Edges | Edges, Edge response | The thin edges, or the edge response R before suppression, stretched so that R = g is white. |
| **Brightness threshold** `brightness` | 25 | 1 to 100 levels | How close in brightness a pixel must be to count as similar to the center, the t of the formula. Our choice of 25, as for the SUSAN corners. |
| **Geometric threshold** `geometric` | 0.75 | 0.1 to 1 | The share of the 37 mask pixels below which a USAN area counts as an edge. The paper uses three quarters for edges. |
| **Minimum length** `minLength` | 5 | 1 to 50 px | Edge pieces, 8-connected, with fewer pixels than this are removed. 1 keeps all. Our choice of 5, in place of the paper's thinning rules. |
| **Border mode** `border` | Reflect 101 (default) | Reflect 101 (default), Reflect, Replicate, Constant (zero), Wrap | How pixels outside the image are filled when the window reaches past the edge. |
